# Create fully native and editable presentations with Gemini in Google Slides

Google has announced a significant update for Google Slides, integrating its Gemini AI to enable the creation of fully native and editable presentations. This new capability empowers users to transform rough notes, bullet points, or even unorganized ideas into a structured and polished slide deck directly within Slides. The system automatically generates initial slide drafts, competently handling much of the basic design and layout, allowing users to bypass manual adjustments to fonts or colors. This integration aims to provide a substantial head start in the presentation creation process, enabling users to focus their efforts primarily on crafting and refining their core message.

## What this means for you

For everyday users, this translates into a much faster and more efficient path from a concept to a presentable first draft of a presentation. You can quickly generate a foundational slide deck from simple textual inputs, significantly reducing the time typically spent on initial formatting and arrangement. This enhanced efficiency frees you to dedicate more attention to the actual content and narrative, ultimately ensuring a more impactful and compelling delivery.
